    • GifMediaEncoder

      public GifMediaEncoder(Path temporaryOutput, int fps, boolean transparent, int[] protectedColors) throws IOException
      Creates a GifMediaEncoder with optional protected UI colors.

      Exact UI colors stay stable while the remaining palette follows each rendered model frame. RGB and ARGB inputs are treated as opaque; at most 192 distinct colors may be protected.

      Parameters:
      temporaryOutput - path to the temporary output file
      fps - frames per second (1–100)
      transparent - true to enable transparency
      protectedColors - array of RGB colors to protect from quantization shifting
      Throws:
      IOException - if encoder initialization fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if frame rate is out of range or too many colors are protected
